extra_vocab.zh: 安裝在……上的、固定在……上的
extra_vocab.en: fixed onto a surface or another part
extra_vocab.note: 文中 mounted on the upper handlebar tube 是過去分詞後置修飾 controls，說明單手操作控制裝置裝在上方手把管上，所以手把必須容納多種機構。
extra_vocab.grammar_note: controls mounted on the tube 等於 controls that are mounted on the tube，過去分詞放在名詞後面修飾；安裝的位置多用 on（mounted on the wall），不用 in。

example.en: The technician mounts each sensor on the metal frame.
example.zh: 技術人員把每個感測器裝在金屬車架上。

example.en: They are mounting the screen on the wall now.
example.zh: 他們現在正在把螢幕裝到牆上。

example.en: The projector is mounted on the wall of the meeting room.
example.zh: 投影機安裝在會議室的牆上。

example.en: We ordered a wall-mounted display for the new showroom.
example.zh: 我們為新的展示間訂了一台壁掛式螢幕。

example.en: The marketing team will mount a campaign for the new model.
example.zh: 行銷團隊將為新機型發起一項宣傳活動。

examples.en: The battery is mounted at the rear of the vehicle.
We need a bracket for the camera mounted above the door.
examples.zh: 我們需要一個支架給裝在門上方的攝影機。

examples.en: Make sure the panel is firmly mounted before you test it.
examples.zh: 測試之前，請確認面板已牢牢固定。

confusable.diff: mountain 是名詞「山」，拼法相近但跟安裝無關。

example.en: The factory is located at the foot of a large mountain.
example.zh: 這間工廠位於一座大山的山腳下。

confusable.diff: amount 是「數量、金額」，字裡含有 mount，但意思完全不同。

example.en: The total amount of the invoice is $2,400.
example.zh: 這張發票的總金額是 2,400 美元。

similar.diff: installed 是「裝好、設置好」，範圍較廣；mounted 強調固定在某個表面上。

example.en: The security cameras were installed on the ceiling last week.
example.zh: 保全攝影機上週已裝在天花板上。

similar.diff: attached 是「附接、連接」，不一定固定在表面上。

example.en: The label is attached to the side of the shipping box.
example.zh: 標籤貼在出貨箱的側面。

example.en: Our team will install the new equipment on Monday.
example.zh: 我們的團隊星期一會安裝新設備。

example.en: Please attach the drawing to your purchase request.
example.zh: 請把圖面附在你的採購申請上。

example.en: This metal bracket holds the control panel in place.
example.zh: 這個金屬支架能固定控制面板的位置。

example.en: The mounted camera records every shipment leaving the warehouse.
example.zh: 裝好的攝影機會記錄離開倉庫的每一批貨。

example.en: Please mount the sign above the main entrance.
example.zh: 請把招牌裝在主要入口上方。

example.en: The monitor comes with a wall mount and two screws.
example.zh: 這台螢幕附有壁掛支架和兩顆螺絲。

senses.en: to fix something onto a surface or frame

example.en: Technicians will mount the sensors on the production line.
example.zh: 技術人員會把感測器裝在生產線上。

senses.en: to start and organize an event or effort
senses.distinguish: 受詞是 campaign、challenge 等活動時，指發起；受詞是實體物品時，指安裝。

example.en: The union plans to mount a challenge to the new policy.
example.zh: 工會打算對新政策提出挑戰。

senses.en: to grow in amount or strength
senses.distinguish: 主詞是 pressure、costs 等抽象名詞時，指逐漸上升。

example.en: Costs continue to mount as the project falls behind schedule.
example.zh: 隨著專案進度落後，成本持續攀升。

extra_vocab.en: made or kept for one special purpose
extra_vocab.note: 文中 a dedicated mold or tooling 指「專門為這個零件製作的模具或工裝」，說明改用碳纖維需要額外投資。dedicated 也常用來形容「敬業的」人。
extra_vocab.grammar_note: be dedicated to 的 to 是介系詞，後面接名詞或 V-ing，不接原形，例如 dedicated to improving quality。

example.en: The company dedicates one floor to research and testing.
example.zh: 公司把一整層樓專門用於研究與測試。

example.en: She is dedicating her time to improving customer service.
example.zh: 她正投入時間改善客戶服務。

example.en: We set up a dedicated team to handle customer complaints.
example.zh: 我們成立了專責團隊來處理客戶投訴。

example.en: Customers can call a dedicated line for technical support.
example.zh: 客戶可以撥打專線取得技術支援。

example.en: Our staff are dedicated to providing fast and reliable service.
example.zh: 我們的員工致力於提供快速可靠的服務。

examples.en: We need a dedicated mold for each new design.
examples.zh: 每個新設計都需要一套專用的模具。

examples.en: The company is looking for a dedicated project manager.
examples.zh: 公司正在找一位專職的專案經理。

examples.en: A dedicated server will keep our customer data secure.
examples.zh: 專用伺服器能確保我們的客戶資料安全。

confusable.diff: delicate 是「精細易損的」，拼法有點像，但跟專用無關。

example.en: Carbon fiber parts are delicate and need careful handling during shipping.
example.zh: 碳纖維零件很精細，出貨時需要小心處理。

similar.diff: specialized 強調專業、特殊化；dedicated 強調專門用於某一目的。

example.en: The factory uses specialized equipment for carbon fiber parts.
example.zh: 這間工廠使用專門的設備來製作碳纖維零件。

similar.diff: devoted 帶有感情，常指人的熱忱投入；dedicated 更偏中性、專用。

example.en: She is devoted to improving the quality of our products.
example.zh: 她全心投入提升我們產品的品質。

example.en: Members receive exclusive access to the new product line.
example.zh: 會員可以獨家取得新產品系列。

example.en: Our team is committed to delivering on time.
example.zh: 我們的團隊致力於準時交貨。

example.en: This tool is designed for a specific type of tube.
example.zh: 這個工具是為特定種類的管子設計的。

example.en: A dedicated support team answers questions around the clock.
example.zh: 專責的支援團隊全天候回答問題。

example.en: We will dedicate more resources to product testing this year.
example.zh: 我們今年會投入更多資源在產品測試上。

senses.en: to give time or money to one purpose

example.en: The firm will dedicate a new line to carbon fiber parts.
example.zh: 公司將把一條新產線專門用於碳纖維零件。

senses.en: to officially name something to honor a person or event
senses.distinguish: 談到典禮、建築、書籍時指獻給，談到資源與時間時指專門投入。

example.en: The company dedicated its new library to the founder.
example.zh: 公司把新圖書館獻給創辦人。

extra_vocab.en: the tools and equipment used to make a product
extra_vocab.note: 文中 custom tooling 指為特定零件量身打造的模具與加工設備；說話者強調使用現成直管，就能省下開發這些設備的成本。
extra_vocab.grammar_note: tooling 是不可數名詞，不加 a 或 s；說「模具費」時用 tooling cost，cost 保持單數。

example.en: Custom tooling can add months to the development schedule.
example.zh: 客製化工裝可能讓開發時程多出好幾個月。

example.en: The tooling cost for this part is around $15,000.
example.zh: 這個零件的模具費用大約是一萬五千美元。

example.en: We must invest in tooling before starting mass production.
example.zh: 我們在開始量產之前必須先投資工裝。

examples.en: The supplier quoted separately for tooling and unit prices.
examples.zh: 供應商把工裝與單價分開報價。

examples.en: New tooling will take about eight weeks to complete.
examples.zh: 新工裝大約需要八週才能完成。

examples.en: Changing the design now would require expensive new tooling.
examples.zh: 現在更改設計會需要昂貴的新工裝。

confusable.diff: tool 是單一工具，可數；tooling 是整套加工設備，不可數。
confusable.usage: tool 是可數名詞（a tool、tools）；tooling 是不可數名詞，不加 s。

example.en: A hand tool is cheap, but tooling for mass production is expensive.
example.zh: 手工具很便宜，但量產用的工裝很昂貴。

similar.diff: equipment 泛指各種設備；tooling 專指製造零件所需的模具與工具。

example.en: The factory needs new equipment to produce the carbon fiber frames.
example.zh: 這間工廠需要新設備來生產碳纖維車架。

similar.diff: molds and dies 專指模具與沖模，是 tooling 的一部分。

example.en: The supplier will build the molds and dies within six weeks.
example.zh: 供應商會在六週內完成模具與沖模。

example.en: The mold must be cleaned after every production run.
example.zh: 每次生產之後，模具都必須清潔。

example.en: A worn die can cause defects in the final product.
example.zh: 磨損的沖模可能讓成品出現瑕疵。

example.en: This fixture holds the tube steady during drilling.
example.zh: 這個治具能在鑽孔時固定管子。

derived.link: tooling = tool + -ing，把「工具」整體變成不可數名詞
tool + box，裝工具的箱子，像 lunchbox

extra_vocab.en: ready to buy and use without special changes
extra_vocab.note: 文中 off-the-shelf tubes 指市面上現成的標準管材，不需要客製加工，所以能直接採購、降低成本。
extra_vocab.grammar_note: 放在名詞前當形容詞時要加連字號（off-the-shelf parts）；放在 be 動詞後可寫成 off the shelf，例如 These parts are available off the shelf。

example.en: Off-the-shelf software is cheaper than a fully custom system.
example.zh: 現成軟體比完全客製的系統便宜。

example.en: An off-the-shelf solution may not fit our special requirements.
example.zh: 現成的解決方案可能不符合我們的特殊需求。

example.en: Using off-the-shelf parts shortens the overall development schedule.
example.zh: 使用現成零件能縮短開發時程。

examples.en: We chose an off-the-shelf motor to keep the cost low.
examples.zh: 我們選用現成的馬達以壓低成本。

examples.en: Off-the-shelf products are available immediately, so delivery is fast.
examples.zh: 現成產品可以立即取得，所以交貨很快。

examples.en: Please check whether an off-the-shelf option meets our needs.
examples.zh: 請確認現成的選項是否符合我們的需求。

confusable.diff: on the shelf 是「在架上」，也可指「被擱置」，和「現成」的意思不同。

example.en: The project has been on the shelf since last spring.
example.zh: 這個專案從去年春天起就被擱置了。

similar.diff: ready-made 也是現成的，用法更口語，常指成品或現成的答案。

example.en: The company bought ready-made components instead of building its own.
example.zh: 公司買了現成的零件，而不是自己製造。

similar.diff: standard 強調規格統一、是常規款，不一定是現貨。

example.en: We chose a standard part to keep the price low.
example.zh: 我們選用標準零件以壓低價格。

example.en: The client ordered a custom design for the new lobby.
example.zh: 客戶為新大廳訂製了專屬設計。

example.en: A generic part is usually cheaper than a branded one.
example.zh: 通用零件通常比品牌零件便宜。

extra_vocab.en: to find and buy materials or products from a supplier
extra_vocab.note: 文中 source them directly 指直接找供應商採購這些現成的碳纖維管，不必另外開發客製工裝。source 當動詞是採購與供應鏈常用字。
extra_vocab.grammar_note: source 當動詞時直接接受詞（source materials），向誰採購用 from（source parts from local suppliers）。

example.en: The company sources its raw materials from three countries.
example.zh: 這家公司從三個國家採購原料。

example.en: We sourced all the parts from local suppliers last year.
example.zh: 我們去年所有零件都向本地供應商採購。

example.en: The purchasing team is sourcing a new supplier for tubes.
example.zh: 採購團隊正在為管材尋找新的供應商。

example.en: It is hard to source materials during the holiday season.
example.zh: 假期期間很難採購到材料。

example.en: We prefer to source from suppliers close to our factory.
example.zh: 我們偏好向靠近工廠的供應商採購。

example.en: The restaurant sources its ingredients locally to reduce costs.
example.zh: 這家餐廳在當地採購食材以降低成本。

examples.en: Can you source three hundred units by the end of May?
examples.zh: 你能在五月底前採購到三百個嗎？

examples.en: We will source the parts directly from the manufacturer.
examples.zh: 我們會直接向製造商採購這些零件。

examples.en: Please let me know if you can source an alternative.
examples.zh: 如果你能找到替代品，請告訴我。

confusable.diff: sauce 是「醬汁」，發音和 source 相近，但意思完全不同。

example.en: The restaurant buys its sauce from a local supplier.
example.zh: 這家餐廳向本地供應商購買醬汁。

confusable.diff: course 是「課程、路線」，發音與 source 有點像。

example.en: The training course starts at nine on Monday morning.
example.zh: 訓練課程在星期一早上九點開始。

similar.diff: procure 較正式，常用於公家或大型採購；source 較口語，強調找貨源。

example.en: The department will procure new equipment before the end of June.
example.zh: 該部門將在六月底前採購新設備。

similar.diff: purchase 只是「購買」；source 還包含找到供應商的過程。

example.en: We plan to purchase the tubes directly from the manufacturer.
example.zh: 我們打算直接向製造商購買這些管子。

example.en: Our main supplier delivers the goods every Tuesday morning.
example.zh: 我們的主要供應商每週二早上送貨。

example.en: The vendor offered a discount for large orders.
example.zh: 這家廠商對大量訂單提供折扣。

example.en: The factory supplies parts to several car makers.
example.zh: 這間工廠供應零件給好幾家車廠。

derived.link: re- + source，再次湧出的來源，就是可用的資源
out + source，把工作往外找來源，交給外部公司

example.en: We source our packaging materials from a nearby supplier.
example.zh: 我們的包裝材料向附近的供應商採購。

example.en: The main source of the delay was a late shipment.
example.zh: 延誤的主要原因是貨物晚到。
